description: Header file defining the AudioProfile class and related classes/functions for managing audio profile configurations in Android, including format, channels, sample rates, and parcelable conversions.

classes.name: AudioProfile
classes.description: Represents an audio profile with format, channels, sample rates, and encapsulation type, supporting dynamic configurations and parcelable conversions.

classes.name: AudioProfileVector
classes.description: A vector container for AudioProfile objects with methods for managing and querying profiles.

methods.name: createFullDynamic
methods.description: Creates a full dynamic AudioProfile with optional format.

methods.name: getFormat
methods.description: Returns the audio format of the profile.

methods.name: getChannels
methods.description: Returns the set of channel masks.

methods.name: getSampleRates
methods.description: Returns the set of sample rates.

methods.name: setChannels
methods.description: Sets the channel masks.

methods.name: setSampleRates
methods.description: Sets the sample rates.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the profile data.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the profile has valid format, channels, and rates.

methods.name: supportsChannels
methods.description: Checks if specific channels are supported.

methods.name: supportsRate
methods.description: Checks if a specific sample rate is supported.

methods.name: hasValidFormat
methods.description: Checks if the format is valid.

methods.name: hasValidRates
methods.description: Checks if sample rates are valid.

methods.name: hasValidChannels
methods.description: Checks if channels are valid.

methods.name: setDynamicChannels
methods.description: Sets whether channels are dynamic.

methods.name: isDynamicChannels
methods.description: Returns whether channels are dynamic.

methods.name: setDynamicRate
methods.description: Sets whether rate is dynamic.

methods.name: isDynamicRate
methods.description: Returns whether rate is dynamic.

methods.name: setDynamicFormat
methods.description: Sets whether format is dynamic.

methods.name: isDynamicFormat
methods.description: Returns whether format is dynamic.

methods.name: isDynamic
methods.description: Checks if any property is dynamic.

methods.name: getEncapsulationType
methods.description: Returns the encapsulation type.

methods.name: setEncapsulationType
methods.description: Sets the encapsulation type.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs profile details to a string.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another profile.

methods.name: toParcelable
methods.description: Converts to parcelable Aidl representation.

methods.name: fromParcelable
methods.description: Creates profile from parcelable Aidl data.

methods.name: toCommonParcelable
methods.description: Converts to common parcelable representation.

methods.name: fromCommonParcelable
methods.description: Creates profile from common parcelable data.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a profile to the vector.

methods.name: clearProfiles
methods.description: Clears dynamic profiles.

methods.name: getFirstValidProfile
methods.description: Returns the first valid profile.

methods.name: getFirstValidProfileFor
methods.description: Returns the first valid profile for a specific format.

methods.name: hasValidProfile
methods.description: Checks if any valid profile exists.

methods.name: getSupportedFormats
methods.description: Returns supported formats.

methods.name: hasDynamicChannelsFor
methods.description: Checks for dynamic channels for a format.

methods.name: hasDynamicFormat
methods.description: Checks for dynamic format.

methods.name: hasDynamicProfile
methods.description: Checks for dynamic profile.

methods.name: hasDynamicRateFor
methods.description: Checks for dynamic rate for a format.

methods.name: getSampleRatesFor
methods.description: Returns sample rates for a format.

methods.name: getChannelMasksFor
methods.description: Returns channel masks for a format.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a profile is contained in the vector.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs vector details to a string.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another vector.

methods.name: addAllValidProfiles
methods.description: Adds all valid profiles from another vector.

methods.name: intersectAudioProfiles
methods.description: Returns intersection of two profile vectors.
